intents.default_response: Undergraduate B.Tech programs require a minimum of 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics in Class 12 with a valid JEE/CUET score. Postgraduate programs require at least 55% in graduation in the relevant discipline. Reserved categories receive a 5% relaxation.
